projects.name: KYTC Current Highway Plan Projects (Active Highway Plan)
projects.notes: Enacted six-year highway plan joined to route geometry; the layer is a join, so every field name carries the full table prefix (KYTCDynamic_Highways.DBO.TED_CHIPS_ACTIVEPLAN.* and KYTCDynamic_Highways.DBO.Project_Locations_Line.*) and must be used that way in outFields. There is one set of phase columns per phase, suffixed P (planning), D (design), R (right of way), U (utilities), C (construction): SYP_RPT_PHASECODEx, SYP_RPT_CSYFUNDCOSTx (cost), SYP_RPT_CSYFISYEARx (fiscal year), SYP_RPT_STAGEx (ESTIMATED / REESTIMATED / AUTHORIZED / SENTTOFHWA / NOTREQUIRED / NON-SIXYEAR / UNK), SYP_RPT_AUTHAMOUNTx, SYP_RPT_AUTHDATEx. Planned vs under way: construction stage 'ESTIMATED' with a future SYP_RPT_CSYFISYEARC = planned; 'AUTHORIZED' = funded/under way; a non-null R phase (SYP_RPT_CSYFISYEARR, values 2021-2032) flags right-of-way acquisition. SYP_RPT_PRECONFLAG meaning of 'A'/'I' is not documented on the service (the awarded layer uses the same field). There is no letting date, only fiscal years. PRECON_INFO_LINK gives a per-project report URL. Total cost = sum of the five phase costs. Layer 0 of the same service ('Awarded Current Highway Plan Projects', 52 records) is the already-awarded subset; layer 2 is the previous plan. maxRecordCount 1000.

parcels_counties.notes: LINK-GIS (Northern Kentucky) layer 'Parcels_KC_PVA'. OWNER2 and OWNERICO (in care of) also present; OWNER_NAME / MAIL_ADD1 / MAIL_STATE duplicate the same data. ACREAGE is text ('.350'). No value field.

LINK-GIS layer 'Parcels_CC' (Campbell County PVA). OWNER_NAME_2, BUSINESS_NAME; LAND_VALUE, IMPROVEMENT_VALUE, TAXABLE_ASSESSMENT; SALE_DATE, SALE_PRICE; TAX_YEAR 2026 in the sample. Layer 2 of the same service is Pendleton County (not inspected).

Boone County Planning Commission (ArcGIS Online, updated November 2026). PRCLOWNR2 second owner; MAILPOST is the mailing city; SITEPOST / SITEZIP site city and ZIP; SALEDATE1 / SALEPRICE1; ASSESSVALU was empty in the sample record.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found for this layer (no licence or description on the service). Kentucky context, read at https://revenue.ky.gov/PVANetwork/PVA%20Forms/PVAGISProductLicenseAgreement.pdf (Department of Revenue template 'County Property Valuation Administrator GIS Products License Agreement'): 'The Licensee is not permitted to make copies of the Product(s) for resale, lease or rent to any third party, or to reverse engineer or to otherwise develop any derivative digital data for commercial sale and/or distribution which incorporates wholly or in part any of the Product(s) without the written consent of the Licensor.' and fees are 'determined by the current GIS Fee Guidelines adopted for use in the PVA office'. That template governs data licensed from a PVA office; whether Daviess PVA applies it to this openly served layer is not stated anywhere found.
parcels_counties.notes: Served from the Owensboro regional sewer agency's (RWRA) ArcGIS server as hosted layer 'parcel'; rows link to the Daviess County PVA public site (website field, qpublic.schneidercorp.com AppID=599). city_st_zi holds mailing city, state and ZIP in one string; prop_addre is the street without number, full_prope the full site address, house_numb the number; lot_size is text. No value field. Update date not published.

summary: Projects: KYTC's enacted highway plan is a good planned-projects source with per-phase cost and fiscal year, including a right-of-way phase. Parcels: no statewide layer; Kenton, Campbell and Boone county layers with owner and mailing address are verified; Louisville and Lexington are not.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide Kentucky parcel layer with owner names was found (ArcGIS Online catalog search returned none; parcels are held by each county PVA).
parcels_counties_not_found: Jefferson (Louisville): LOJIC's open-data parcel layer https://gis.lojic.org/maps/rest/services/LojicSolutions/OpenDataPVA/MapServer/1 timed out and is not verified. Fayette (Lexington) and Warren: no public parcel service with owner names found in the time allowed. The three verified counties are the Northern Kentucky ones, not the most populous.
parcels_second_pass: Second pass 2026-11-17 (parcels only). Statewide: still none. Kentucky's GIS server (kygisserver.ky.gov, WGS84WM_Services) now lists a PVA parcel service for Webster County only; the Hardin County one found by search (Ky_PVA_Hardin_Parcels_WGS84WM) answers 404, and the same name pattern for Jefferson, Fayette, Warren, Daviess, Madison, Boone, Kenton and Campbell does not exist. Kenton, Campbell and Boone were already on file. Added Daviess. NOT FOUND: JEFFERSON - LOJIC's gis.lojic.org timed out again on every request (TLS handshake), so its open-data PVA parcel layer is still unverified. FAYETTE - Lexington's parcel layer (services1.arcgis.com/Mg7DLdfYcSWIaDnu/.../Parcel/FeatureServer/0, 114,511 rows) answers spatial queries but has only PVANUM, ADDRESS and PVA_ACRE, no owner. WARREN - a 'City County Planning Commission Land Parcels (2024)' service is registered at webgis.bgky.org/server/rest/services/CCPC/CCPC_Parcels/FeatureServer but timed out; fields unknown. HARDIN - Elizabethtown's parcel layer (12,471 rows, city only) has address and PIDN but no owner. MADISON - arcserver.madisoncountyky.us County_Parcels/MapServer/1 (39,129 rows) has Parcel_ID and Acres only, no owner. All Kentucky owner data comes from county PVA offices, which license GIS data to commercial users under the Department of Revenue template quoted on the Daviess entry; the three Northern Kentucky entries already on file were not re-checked against it.
